releases.title: Snake v0.3.0 (game over holds for the final score)
releases.author: game-developer
releases.body:
This is the assembled delivery: world/game-developer `f84f9d3c2a8d29f28951a97e5d34a0b2369f4187` + world/artist `assets/` at `766d875de16320c21d87430f185052dececf080a`.

Change since v0.2.2: for 500 ms after death, the game-over screen ignores Enter, Space and clicks, and the Play again button shows dimmed meanwhile. After that, Play again works as before. This answers game-developer#4. The art now includes the artist's smoother body corners.

To start it, download `snake-v0.3.0.zip`, unzip it, and open `snake/index.html`. Or run `python3 -m http.server 8000` inside `snake/` and open http://localhost:8000/.

Controls: Enter, Space or a click starts the game and plays again. Arrow keys turn. P or Esc pauses. M toggles sound.

Checked: `python3 tests/test_game.py` inside `snake/` passed 41/41 in headless Chromium, with zero failed requests and zero console errors. Over file:// the 29 rule checks pass.

releases.title: Snake v0.2.2 (centred title logo)
releases.author: game-developer
releases.body:
This is the assembled delivery: world/game-developer `531454bad619258a0e714ac65e61fbedde608748` + world/artist `assets/` at `5a7d526900f4940c377569485074601317cabdfe`. It has the same gameplay as v0.2.1; the title logo is now centred (artist fix), and the tests cover the brief's priority-3 input rules.

To start it, download `snake-v0.2.2.zip`, unzip it, and open `snake/index.html` in a browser. Or run `python3 -m http.server 8000` inside `snake/` and open http://localhost:8000/.

Controls: Enter, Space or a click starts the game and plays again. Arrow keys turn. P or Esc pauses. M toggles sound.

Checked: `python3 tests/test_game.py` inside `snake/` passed 40/40 in headless Chromium. That covers R1–R11, two quick presses within one tick, a reverse press being ignored, arrow keys not scrolling the page, every artist asset loading, zero failed requests and zero console errors.

releases.title: Snake v0.2.1 (art and sound, no console errors)
releases.author: game-developer
releases.body:
This is the assembled delivery: world/game-developer `b4c61e10cbd7e6e9377fd611643c1862a94b8d44` + world/artist `assets/` at `aba47b954bd9086339e6aada5f30f1746618075e`. It supersedes v0.2.0, which also requested two optional files that don't exist and so logged 404s.

To start it, download `snake-v0.2.1.zip`, unzip it, and open `snake/index.html` in a browser. Or run `python3 -m http.server 8000` inside `snake/` and open http://localhost:8000/.

Controls: Enter, Space or a click starts the game and plays again. Arrow keys turn (the snake can't reverse). P or Esc pauses; the game also pauses when the window loses focus. M toggles sound.

Checked: `python3 tests/test_game.py` inside `snake/` passed 37/37 in headless Chromium. The checks cover the title screen, grid movement, all four arrow turns, no reversal, +1 cell and +1 point per food, the HUD score, death at the wall and on the snake's own body, the game-over screen with the final score, Play again by click and by Enter, all 6 artist images and 4 sounds loading, zero failed requests and zero console errors. Over file:// the 25 rule checks pass. Sound playback wasn't heard; the check covers loading only.
